comment: Target sizes used by furniture_cc0.place_all / kit_normalize. Footprints match the existing Two Bed stand-in layout so positions stay valid. Typical manufactured sizes cited where a public spec exists.

sofa_3seat.notes: Stand-in 3-seat navy sofa. Typical 3-seat ~180–230 cm wide.

coffee_table.notes: Stand-in rectangular coffee table (0.55×1.05, top at 0.42 m).

tv_bench.notes: Stand-in TV bench 1.5 m wide, 0.4 m deep. Height slightly taller than the 0.36 m stand-in body so the CC0 sideboard keeps its doors.

dining_table_round.notes: Stand-in round table radius 0.45 m, top at 0.74 m. BS EN 1729 / typical dining height 720–760 mm.

dining_chair.notes: Poly Haven dining_chair_02 kept near native size (seat ~0.45 m). Typical dining chair seat 430–460 mm.

bed_double.notes: Stand-in 1.45×2.05 m (between UK double 1350 mm and king 1500 mm). Headboard against the north wall.

storage_shelving.notes: Width taken from the storage room (same as the stand-in block). Depth 0.4 m, height 2.2 m.

kitchen_base_unit.notes: Stand-in 0.58×0.597×0.78 plus 40 mm worktop at 0.88 m. UK base unit 600 mm module, 720 mm carcass + worktop ~900 mm.

kitchen_wall_unit.notes: Stand-in wall unit 0.33 m deep, 0.72 m tall, centre at z=1.95.

electric_stove.notes: Typical 60 cm freestanding cooker, hob flush with 0.88–0.90 m worktop.

microwave.notes: Fits in a wall unit opening (stand-in frame 0.58×0.40).

fridge_tall.notes: Fills the leftover tall slot at the end of the kitchen run.

shower.notes: Stand-in 0.9×0.9 m tray, glass ~2.0 m high.

kitchen_sink_unit.notes: Kenney sink includes the mixer tap, so the unit is 0.90 m tall (base carcass still 0.78 m, same 600 mm module as kitchen_base_unit).

bedside_lamp.notes: Small mushroom bedside lamp, ~320 mm tall. Typical table lamp shade 150–200 mm.
